SchemeAssignedIdentification.name: Scheme Assigned Identification
SchemeAssignedIdentification.definition: Unique identification to the acceptor assigned by the scheme

LegalCorporateName.name: Legal Corporate Name
LegalCorporateName.definition: Legal Corporate Name of the party.

AppliedAddress.name: Applied Address
AppliedAddress.definition: Applied or corrected address of the acceptor.

NameAndLocation.name: Name And Location
NameAndLocation.definition: Name and location of acceptor.  May only contain name and not location if the location is specified elsewhere.

BusinessRegistrationIdentification.name: Business Registration Identification
BusinessRegistrationIdentification.definition: Contains business registration Identification of the acceptor.

BusinessRegistrationIdentificationType.name: Business Registration Identification Type
BusinessRegistrationIdentificationType.definition: Contains the type of acceptor's business registration Identification.

LocalData.name: Local Data
LocalData.definition: Contains local language equivalent(s) of data in the current component.

AdditionalTransactionReferenceNumber.name: Additional Transaction Reference Number
AdditionalTransactionReferenceNumber.definition: Contains a code that facilitates card acceptor/corporation communication and record keeping.

PartnerIdentification.name: Partner Identification
PartnerIdentification.definition: Identifies a specific partnership agreement, generally between specific acceptors and issuers.

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.
